subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag indicating they reviewed the patch and found it acceptable.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: The patch addresses a spurious allocation failure issue in the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism. It detects zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add and gates sequence checks on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG to prevent concurrent GFP_KERNEL | __GFP_THISNODE allocations from failing even when there is free ZONE_NORMAL memory available.
